_comment: Contents of <theme.wcmPath> (ThemeDS/ThemeSetting) that theme.html calls with st_wcm_content, copied from the reference ÓRBITA site. Each content is wcm/themesetting/contents/<name>.html in the field <element> of <contentTemplate>. The components go to Components/<componentFolder> of the theme library: customColors.css and headerContent call them by name. The installer owns this code: a content or component that differs is updated.
